title: VERTEBRATE BIOLOGY LABORATORY
description: Classification, identification, and natural history of vertebrates. Includes laboratory examination of specimens and frequent field trips (fee charged) emphasizing Oregon fauna. Lab fee.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (((BI 221Z or 221HZ) and (BI 222Z or 222HZ) and (BI 223Z or 223HZ)) or ((BI 221 or 221H) and (BI 222 or 222H) and (BI 223 or 223H)) or (BI 204, 205 and 206)) and Z 371*.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BI 221Z, BI 221HZ, BI 222Z, BI 222HZ, BI 223Z, BI 223HZ, BI 221, BI 221H, BI 222, BI 222H, BI 223, BI 223H, BI 204, BI 205 and BI 206.
A minimum grade of D- is required in Z 371.

Enrollment is limited to students with a major in Biology (509) or Zoology (620).
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
Field trip fee. Other majors may be able to register in Week 10.
